paragraphs: Yehudah ben Gedidya, in King Yannai’s time, Kiddushin 66a. He told King Yannai, “The crown of kingship is enough for you.”[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson paragraph at Kiddushin 66a names Yehudah ben Gedidya addressing King Yannai and contains the quoted crown-of-kingship sentence. The supplied quotation remains abridged, and Hyman’s dating parenthesis remains his account; the continuation and other figures are not imported.
